name: Curonian Spit
description: The Curonian Spit is a thin, curved ribbon of sand stretching 98 km along the Baltic coast, shared by Lithuania and Russia's Kaliningrad region. It separates the sea from the Curonian Lagoon and is only a few hundred metres wide at its narrowest. People have lived here since prehistoric times, and the pine forests and grassy dunes you see today exist because generations kept fighting wind and shifting sand.
